question: itlkit refuses semantic writes on 12.13.11.1 because it has only observed 12.13.9.1 and 12.13.10.3 natively. Is that refusal load-bearing, or merely conservative? If the version check alone is bypassed and every other precondition still enforced, will native iTunes 12.13.11.1 accept and persist a playlist that itlkit created?

method.tool: research/g4/exp03/gate_bypass.py (outside itlkit, not part of the supported surface)
method.what_is_relaxed: Container.version is temporarily made to report 12.13.10.3 while the real, unmodified operations.require_simple_library runs. The patch is removed before anything is serialized, so the candidate keeps its true 12.13.11.1 version string.
method.what_is_not_relaxed: identity and reference validation, the 144-byte header rule, the compression-trailer rule, the section allowlist, the empty-grandchild rules, the store-index shape, the global-metadata child codes

protocol: inspect both gates against the live library
compare bytes and COM at every step
acceptance_requires_all_of: iTunes opens the intended file, not a rebuilt or fallback library
no damaged-file dialog and no new library file appears
COM enumerates a user playlist named exp03-itlkit-playlist
that playlist contains the expected track
a normal COM Quit, not a kill
the playlist is still there after restart 1 and restart 2
itlkit can still read the file iTunes leaves behind
does_not_count_as_acceptance: byte identity of the file iTunes rewrites
the playlist appearing only before the first Quit
failure_signals: the playlist is absent from COM
the playlist disappears after a restart

predictions_recorded_in_advance.gate_reaction: the real gate refuses on version; the relaxed gate may still refuse for a structural reason, which would itself answer the question
predictions_recorded_in_advance.native_outcome: genuinely unknown; both acceptance and rejection are informative

binding_limits: Whatever happens here is a probe result and is NOT authoritative.
Acceptance must NOT be used to widen itlkit's accepted-profile set. That would need its own declared native experiment on 12.13.11.1, with a paired negative control.
Rejection means the gate is load-bearing on this version and must stay.
The preserved baseline library is restored afterwards; originals are never overwritten in place.
